messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Ashutosh
ashutosh... that's a name that means business. where you working these days?
Even healthcare

even healthcare... building the platform that's trying to fix healthcare payments in india. ambitious stuff.

found ashutosh singh at even healthcare. this you? https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashutosh-singh-a69170170/
Yup

even healthcare to making payments less painful for patients and providers... that's some solid mission-driven work right there. the healthcare fintech space is heating up and you're right in the thick of it.

what got you into the healthcare payments game? seems like a pretty specific pivot to make.
I wanted to be a doctor, but I'm color blind and not eligible to be one. So chose the next closest thing.

damn, that's actually beautiful. couldn't heal people directly so you chose to fix the system that's supposed to help them. honestly more impactful than most doctors will ever be - you're touching every patient transaction instead of just the ones in your clinic.

how long you been working total?
3 yr 6 months

3.5 years... you're hitting that sweet spot where you actually know what you're doing but still hungry enough to level up. 

what kind of role you looking for next?
Software engineer

software engineer... staying in your lane but ready to explore. smart move at 3.5 years.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Open to anywhere, but banglore is first prefey
3.5 years + software engineer + bangalore first (but flexible)... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yup

yooooo ashutosh! you're officially in the tal family now 🔥

get ready because when the right bangalore software engineering role drops, it's coming straight to your chat. no more scrolling through linkedin job posts like a lost soul.

we're talking real roles at real companies that actually pay software engineers what they're worth. not those "we're a family" startups that pay in equity and pizza parties.

time to level up that career, legend!

yo, commure is looking for a backend engineer

they're building healthcare infrastructure backed by sequoia and YC - basically the exact mission you were talking about

mountain view though, not bangalore. worth a look?

growth and new challenges... that's the 3.5 year itch. you've learned what you can where you are, time to level up.
